pergunta: According to NAP5, was distress or longer-term psychological harm after awareness more likely when the patient was paralysed?
esperado: sim: paralisia associada a sofrimento e dano duradouro (Cook et al., 2014)
resposta: Sim, o sofrimento e o dano a longo prazo foram particularmente prováveis quando o paciente experimentou paralisia. | "Distress and longer term harm occurred across the full range of experiences but were particularly likely when the patient experienced paralysis (with or without pain)." | https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25204696

linhas.fato: Sim, o sofrimento e o dano a longo prazo foram particularmente prováveis quando o paciente experimentou paralisia.
linhas.citacao: Distress and longer term harm occurred across the full range of experiences but were particularly likely when the patient experienced paralysis (with or without pain).
